num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the directed network.
num_commodities: <int> Total number of distinct commodities to be shipped through the network.
num_scenarios: <int> Total number of equally likely demand scenarios.
num_edges: <int> Total number of directed edges (arcs) in the network.
gamma: <float> Regularization parameter controlling the strength of the quadratic congestion penalty on edge flows.
c_0: <int> Maximum number of edges that may be activated (constructed) across the entire network.
node_positions: <list[list[float]], shape [num_nodes][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates of each node in the unit square.
edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Ordered pair of origin and destination node indices for each directed edge.
construction_costs: <list[float], length num_edges> Fixed cost incurred for activating (constructing) each edge.
flow_costs: <list[float], length num_edges> Per-unit transportation cost for shipping one unit of any commodity along each edge.
edge_lengths: <list[float], length num_edges> Euclidean distance between the endpoints of each edge.
capacities: <list[float], length num_edges> Maximum total flow of all commodities combined that each edge can carry in any scenario.
commodity_destinations: <list[int], length num_commodities> Index of the single destination (sink) node for each commodity.
demands: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [num_scenarios][num_commodities][num_nodes]> Net supply (positive) or demand (negative) at each node for each commodity in each scenario, where each commodity's values sum to zero across all nodes.
